Horizon M1 - quick install
==========================

Horizon is an unofficial native (Rust) version of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3.
This build is tuned for Apple Silicon Macs (M1/M2/M3/M4) with 8 GB of memory.
You need Minecraft: Java Edition. Horizon contains no Minecraft files: it makes
them on your Mac from your own copy.

1. Control-click (or two-finger click) "Install Horizon M1.command", choose
   Open, then Open again. A plain double-click will not work the first time.
   (macOS 15 or newer may block it: click Done, then Apple menu > System
   Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll to the bottom, click "Open Anyway"
   next to the installer's name, and open it again.)
2. A Terminal window (a text window, that is normal) asks two questions.
   Type the number and press Return:
   - the look: 1 full (all packs + shader), 2 fast, 3 plain.
     Just pressing Return picks 1, the full look;
   - how you play: 1 Microsoft account (normal), then sign in and press Play
     in the Horizon launcher that opens;
     or 2 Offline (no sign-in): pick a player name, then play with
     "Horizon Offline" from Launchpad. Offline needs Minecraft Java 26.3:
     the installer finds it if it was launched once in any Minecraft
     launcher, or type d to sign in once and download it from Mojang.
3. Next time: open Horizon (Microsoft) or Horizon Offline from Launchpad.
   No need to run the installer again.
4. Your worlds live in ~/Library/Application Support/horizon

To remove it: Control-click "Uninstall Horizon M1.command" > Open. It moves
Horizon to the Trash and asks before touching your worlds.

Full guide and troubleshooting: https://github.com/tm-droid/horizon-m1#readme
Credits and licenses: the LICENSES folder.
